statements.proposition: Every change in this PR is additive, gated behind the NEXT_PUBLIC_TEAMS_ENABLED flag, and isolated, with no breaking change to existing functionality or the database schema.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Compound claim. The additive and no-breaking-schema parts hold (new TeamsInstallation model plus back-relation fields; the other schema diff lines are whitespace re-alignment; no existing column changed). But 'feature-flagged' is not true of the change as a whole: in the diff only the TeamsIntegration component and teams/setup/page.tsx check NEXT_PUBLIC_TEAMS_ENABLED. The /api/teams/auth, /callback, /webhook and /api/user/teams/installation routes and the teams/installed and teams/tab pages have no flag check, so they are live regardless of the flag. Also the settings page only adds an import of TeamsIntegration (+1 -0) and does not render it. Rule applied by judgment: the sentence says 'All changes ... feature-flagged', read literally. No migration file is in the change list (not weighed). Read from diff only; no code run.
evidence: gh api pulls/765/files: 20 files, 17 added or non-schema; schema.prisma +58 -32, settings/page.tsx +1 -0 (import only)
grep of full patch for TEAMS_ENABLED: used only in app/(app)/settings/TeamsIntegration.tsx (returns null if disabled) and app/(app)/teams/setup/page.tsx, plus env.ts definition and docs

api/teams/auth/route.ts, callback/route.ts, webhook/route.ts, api/user/teams/installation/route.ts: patches contain no reference to NEXT_PUBLIC_TEAMS_ENABLED (they check only MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID/SECRET)
schema.prisma patch: adds model TeamsInstallation and relation fields on User and EmailAccount; other changed lines are whitespace alignment only
